-- ============================================================
-- test-13-let-mut_pos.fh  –  let & Mutation PASS-Tests
--   (LET-01..07, MUT-01..03)
-- ============================================================
module Test.LetMut.Pos

import Test.Support exposing Point, make_point, NotFound

-- LET-01: Alle Basistypen
function all_let_types() returns Integer
is
    let i:   Integer    = 42
    let d:   Double     = 3.14
    let s:   String     = "hallo"
    let b:   Boolean    = true
    let big: BigInteger = Big.fromInteger(99)
    return i
end all_let_types

-- LET-02: Feldzugriff als Initialwert
function let_field(p: Point) returns Integer
requires p.x >= 0
ensures result >= 0
is
    let x: Integer = p.x
    let y: Integer = p.y
    return x + y
end let_field

-- LET-03: Funktionsaufruf als Initialwert
function let_call(n: Integer) returns Integer
requires n > 0
ensures result > 0
is
    let p: Point   = make_point(n, n)
    let x: Integer = p.x
    return x
end let_call

function make_result(n: Integer) returns Result<Integer, NotFound>
requires n > 0
ensures success, value > 0
is
    return ok n
end make_result

-- LET-07: let mit Result-Typ
function let_result(n: Integer) returns Integer
requires n > 0
ensures result > 0
is
    let r: Result<Integer, NotFound> = make_result(n)
    let v: Integer = r.value
    return v
end let_result

-- LET-07: let mit Array-Typ
function let_array(a: Integer, b: Integer) returns Integer
requires a >= 0, b >= 0
ensures result >= 0
is
    let arr: Array<Integer, 2> = [a, b]
    let first: Integer = arr[0]
    return first
end let_array

-- MUT-01: Variable-Zuweisung x := expr
function assign_var(n: Integer) returns Integer
requires n >= 0
ensures result >= 0
is
    let counter: Integer = 0
    counter := n
    return counter
end assign_var

-- MUT-01: Akkumulator
function accumulate(n: Integer) returns Integer
requires n > 0
ensures result > 0
is
    let total: Integer = 0
    total := total + n
    total := total + 1
    return total
end accumulate

-- MUT-02: Feldzuweisung x.f := expr
procedure update_x(p: Point, new_x: Integer)
requires new_x >= 0
is
    p.x := new_x
    call Std.IO.logf("x = ${}", p.x)
end update_x

-- MUT-03: Tief geschachtelter Pfad
procedure deep_update(n: Integer)
requires n >= 0
is
    let p: Point = make_point(0, 0)
    p.x := n
    call Std.IO.logf("updated x = ${}", p.x)
end deep_update

end Test.LetMut.Pos
